question: Who among the following wrote the book ‘Chanakya’s Chant’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashwin Sanghi**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ashwin Sanghi wrote the book Chanakya's Chant**
 
• Ashwin Sanghi** is Known for Historical and mythological fiction**
 
• **Other works**:The Rozabal Line, The Krishna Key, The Sialkot Saga, Private India, Private Delhi
 
• **Awards -Crossword Popular Choice Award, Atta Galatta Popular Choice Award, WBR Iconic Achievers Award, Lit-O-Fest Literature Legend Award, Kalinga Popular Choice Award**
 
• Chanakya's Chant** was published in 2011 **and became a national bestseller in India within two months.
 
• It tells the story of Chanakya, who seeks revenge against the king in 340 BC, and Gangasagar, who grooms a young girl to become the prime minister of India in modern-day India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amish Tripathi**
